src/main/java/net/legendofwar/minilib/li.summary: `DumpMethods` provides the `dump(Class)` utility to generate boilerplate wrapper code for a given class, facilitating the creation of proxy or wrapper classes within the project.
`FileIO` provides utility methods `readFile` and `writeInFile` for basic file read/write operations, serving as a foundational I/O helper class within the project.

`FieldUtils` provides reflection-based utilities to bypass access modifiers using `sun.misc.Unsafe`. It exports `setFinalStatic`, `getFinalStatic`, `getFinalPrivate`, and `setFinalNonStatic` to manipulate private or final fields at runtime.
`MeasureTime` benchmarks execution duration and logs results. It exports `measure` and `formatDuration`, serving as a performance-tracking utility for the project.
`Healthbar` generates stylized, color-coded health bars for the project. It exports `getColor` and `getHealthbar` to provide visual health representations based on current and maximum health values.
`LGS` provides numerical methods to solve linear equation systems. It exports `solve` and `pivot` to perform Gaussian elimination with partial pivoting for matrix calculations within the project.
`ReadProperties` loads and extracts configuration values from Java property files. It exports the `readProperties` method to provide essential configuration loading for the project.
`Tool` provides utility methods for null-safety, specifically the `requireNonNullElse` function. It serves as a lightweight helper library for common object validation tasks within the project.
`TextWidth` loads character width data from JSON to calculate visual text dimensions. It provides utility methods to retrieve character widths for UI rendering within the project.
